A '''transport''' was used by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] of [[Thrawn's confederation|Thrawn's Empire]] during the [[Ambush on Trogan|ambush]] of the [[Smugglers' Alliance]] on [[Trogan/Legends|Trogan]]. An open-top [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]],<ref name="TLC 2" /> it was deployed alongside two [[LAVr QH-7 Chariot/Legends|LAVr QH-7 Chariots]]<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref> and a division of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Trooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|Army troopers]] during the [[Thrawn campaign]].<ref name="TLC 2" />

The [[Troop transport/Legends|troop transport's]] design resembled the [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]]-based [[Platoon Attack Craft/Legends|Platoon Attack Craft]]<ref name="FF16">{{FactFile|16|MTT 1-2|Trade Federation Multi-Troop Transport}}</ref> used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The transport first appeared in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity's [[The Last Command 2|''The Last Command'' 2]], the second issue of the [[Star Wars: The Last Command (comic series)|comic adaptation]] of ''[[The Last Command]]''. Released on [[December 24]], [[1997]], the [[Star Wars comic books|comic issue]] was written by [[Mike Baron]] and illustrated by [[Edvin Biuković|Edvin Biukovic]] with colors by [[Pamela Rambo]].<ref name="TLC 2" />

[[File:Stormtrooper_transport-ANH.png|thumb|right|The similar craft in the ''Special Edition'' of ''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]
In the early-1997 [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|''Special Edition'']] re-release of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']],<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> a similar craft existed in the form of what in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] is identified as the [[stormtrooper transport]].<ref name="CL2016">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> However, the ''Special Edition'' [[repulsorcraft]] featured a notable distinction from the ''The Last Command'' transport: the [[hull]] that surrounded the ''Special Edition'' [[troop transport]] was bulbous,<ref name="ANH" /> whereas the ''The Last Command'' [[Transport/Legends|transport]] had a less stocky profile.<ref name="TLC 2" />
